lines.text: Roblox players typed seventy thousand games into existence, and someone built a filter to hide them.
Roblox adds Build to its phone app.
You type one sentence, and it makes you a playable game.
Half a million people try it.
Roblox's own help page says simple clickers turn out best.
People are using A.I. to rebuild Counter-Strike on Roblox, almost exactly.
The makers of Peak find a copy of their game and tell fans: pirate ours instead of playing this Roblox slop ripoff.
So if A.I. makes slop, why do over eighty percent of Roblox's top one hundred games use it too?
A.I. is like the camera in your phone.
Everybody has a great one now, and that didn't make everybody a photographer.
The slop isn't the A.I. It's skipping the part where you make it fun.
I made Troll Duels entirely with A.I.
But somebody still had to decide that flipping your friend's screen, dropping a banana, and launching the other team with a bomb is funny.
And this video? Also made with A.I. Did it feel like slop?
